title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Blue Cherry Pineapple 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Blue Cherry Pineapple combines the bold tartness of Blue Raspberry, the deep richness of Cherry, and the tropical sweetness of Pineapple for a layered and vibrant fruit vape. Each inhale bursts with juicy intensity, while the smooth exhale leaves a lasting, refreshing finish. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid delivers fast-acting nicotine satisfaction with a consistently smooth throat hit. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio enhances flavour clarity while ensuring discreet vapour production, making it an excellent choice for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids provide a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, bringing popular flavours to a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
